# symbolicUserJointsTest.py

You can view and download this file on Github: [symbolicUserJointsTest.py](https://github.com/jgerstmayr/EXUDYN/tree/master/python/TestModels/symbolicUserJointsTest.py)

```{code-block} python
:linenos:

#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
# This is an EXUDYN example
#
# Details:  The joints of exudyn.symbolics.userItems.UserItemCreator (#3140) against the built-in joints: a chain of
#           two rigid bars on revolute joints with tilted axes, a body on a prismatic joint pulled by a spring-damper, a
#           bar on a spherical joint and a mass point on a distance constraint to the end of a bar, under gravity. The
#           same script builds the system with the built-in items (creator = mbs) and with ObjectJointUser and
#           ObjectUserBody, with Python and with recorded user functions; SolveDynamic by the generalized-alpha method,
#           the positions and angular velocities of the bodies compared.
#
# Author:   Johannes Gerstmayr
# Date:     2026-10-28
#
# Copyright:This file is part of Exudyn. Exudyn is free software. You can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the Exudyn license. See 'LICENSE.txt' for more details.
#
#+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

import exudyn as exu
from exudyn.utilities import * #includes itemInterface and rigidBodyUtilities
from exudyn.symbolics.userItems import UserItemCreator
import numpy as np

def Bar(creator, position, angularVelocity=[0, 0, 0], velocity=[0, 0, 0]):
    return creator.CreateRigidBody(inertia=InertiaCuboid(density=1000, sideLengths=[0.4, 0.05, 0.03]).Translated([0.02, 0.01, 0]),
                                   referencePosition=position, initialAngularVelocity=angularVelocity, initialVelocity=velocity,
                                   gravity=[0, -9.81, 0], nodeType=exu.NodeType.RotationRxyz)

def Build(userItems, record=False):
    SC = exu.SystemContainer()
    mbs = SC.AddSystem()
    creator = UserItemCreator(mbs) if userItems else mbs
    ground = creator.CreateGround()
    #a double pendulum on revolute joints with tilted axes
    b0 = Bar(creator, [0.2, 0, 0])
    b1 = Bar(creator, [0.6, 0, 0])
    creator.CreateRevoluteJoint(itemNumbers=[ground, b0], position=[0, 0, 0], axis=[0, 0.2, 1])
    creator.CreateRevoluteJoint(itemNumbers=[b0, b1], position=[0.4, 0, 0], axis=[0.1, 0, 1])
    #a body sliding along a tilted axis, pulled by a spring-damper to the ground
    b2 = Bar(creator, [0, -0.5, 0.3], [0, 0, 0])
    creator.CreatePrismaticJoint(itemNumbers=[ground, b2], position=[0, -0.5, 0.3], axis=[1, 0.3, 0])
    creator.CreateSpringDamper(itemNumbers=[ground, b2], localPosition0=[-0.2, -0.5, 0.3], stiffness=200, damping=2)
    #a bar on a spherical joint, spinning about it: the velocity of the node omega x [0.2, 0, 0]
    b3 = Bar(creator, [0.2, 0, 0.8], [0.5, 2, 1], [0, 0.2, -0.4])
    creator.CreateSphericalJoint(itemNumbers=[ground, b3], position=[0, 0, 0.8])
    #a mass point hanging from the end of the bar by a distance constraint; its velocity relative to the end of the
    #bar, [0, 0.4, -0.8], perpendicular to the distance
    point = creator.CreateMassPoint(referencePosition=[0.5, -0.3, 0.8], mass=0.2, gravity=[0, -9.81, 0],
                                    initialVelocity=[0, 0.4, -0.3])
    creator.CreateDistanceConstraint(itemNumbers=[b3, point], localPosition0=[0.2, 0, 0])
    if record:
        creator.Record()
    mbs.variables['creator'] = creator #the recordings live as long as the system
    mbs.Assemble()
    return (SC, mbs, [b0, b1, b2, b3], point)

def State(mbs, bodies, point):
    #the positions of a point off the node and the angular velocities, and the position of the mass point
    return np.array([list(mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(body, exu.OutputVariableType.Position, localPosition=[0.1, 0.02, 0.01]))
                     + list(mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(body, exu.OutputVariableType.AngularVelocity, localPosition=[0, 0, 0]))
                     for body in bodies]
                    + [list(mbs.GetObjectOutputBody(point, exu.OutputVariableType.Position, localPosition=[0, 0, 0])) + [0, 0, 0]])

simulationSettings = exu.SimulationSettings()
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.numberOfSteps = 200
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.endTime = 0.2
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.verboseMode = 0
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.newton.relativeTolerance = 1e-10
simulationSettings.timeIntegration.newton.absoluteTolerance = 1e-12
simulationSettings.solution.file.write = False

results = []
for (userItems, record) in [(False, False), (True, False), (True, True)]:
    (SC, mbs, bodies, point) = Build(userItems, record)
    mbs.SolveDynamic(simulationSettings)
    results.append(State(mbs, bodies, point))
differences = [np.max(np.abs(result - results[0]))/np.max(np.abs(results[0])) for result in results[1:]]
exu.Print('relative difference of the user joints to the built-in joints: Python', differences[0], ', recorded', differences[1])

u = 1 + int(not max(differences) < 1e-8)
exu.Print('solution of symbolicUserJointsTest=', u)

exu.sys['testResult'] = u
```
